purpose: Independent original disease association consistency; validate captured values without replacing them.
allowed_differences: Relative import rebinding; inert captured inputs; frozen pure namespace/native/source/selection grammar; version labels substituted only at declared generated-rule paths; exact cross-capture replay. Original capsule bytes remain fixed. Current and new-format invalid-request labels use disease-association wording; valid scientific outputs and original schema bytes are unchanged. Literal child navigation is a separately specified retained-data capability, not a new scientific query. Identical repeated source references keep their full occurrence counts. Runtime save admission is in capabilities/catalogs, never a rewrite of the original wire schema.

extracted_and_new_predicates.rules.py: Original labels at declared generated disease_association_context@1 and knowledge_state@5 output paths only; no source rewriting.

extracted_and_new_predicates.replay.py: Frozen literal request/support/inspection and explicit exact-capture switching; no acquisition.
extracted_and_new_predicates.exploration.py: SDK227 human/source rules plus explicit retained literal-child inspection of the exact input owner; source occurrences and original initiating contexts stay separate.
